answer_2.quote: We use accuracy as the metric to evaluate different methods, and provide baseline results, as well as human pass mark (60%) instead of human performance due to the wide variations exist in human performance, from almost full marks to cannot even pass the exam.

answer_4.quote: we sampled 5% (681) questions from the development sets of five categories using stratified random sampling, and manually annotate each question by five medical experts with 3 labels: (1) Exactly Match (EM): the retrieved documents exactly match the question. (2) Partial Match (PM): the retrieved documents partially match the question, can be confused with the correct options or are incomplete. (3) Mismatch (MM): the retrieved documents do not match the question at all.
